name: Hardware Monitor
author: Edgar Silva
description: RAM, CPU, and GPU in the bar as sleek icon + figure readouts and temperatures, with a first-class visual system panel.

barWidget.description: Memory, CPU, and GPU load as sleek icon readouts with temperatures, vertical gauges, or spelled out words. Left click opens the system telemetry panel.

schema.label: Readout
schema.description: icons is sleek icon + figures + temperature; compact is glyph + gauge; full adds the temperature; labels spells the readout out as words — RAM 11/23G · CPU 34% 46° — with no glyph or gauge. Right-clicking the widget cycles them.

schema.label: Monitors
schema.description: Which screens to draw on, by connector name — 'DP-1', or 'DP-1,HDMI-A-1'. Empty means all of them. The bar mounts one widget per monitor and has no per-monitor filter of its own, so an instance hides itself on the screens it was not asked for, and stops sampling there too.

schema.label: Show percentages
schema.description: Put the numbers back on the row beside each gauge in compact/full modes. (icons and labels always show them).

schema.label: Memory readout
schema.description: Only applies when Show percentages is on.

schema.label: Temperature marker
schema.description: 45°, 45C, 45c, 45°C, or 45. In a monospace face the degree sign owns a whole character cell but inks only a small ring at the top of it, so it reads as a gap before whatever follows — a letter fills the cell and evens out the spacing.

schema.label: Percentage width
schema.description: How a percentage holds its width so the group does not resize as the figure gains a digit. lead pads with a space (' 3%'), zero pads with a zero ('03%'), trail reserves the leftover after the group, none lets it size naturally without padding zero. A pad character is a full cell in a monospace face, so lead puts a gap between a label and its figure where zero puts ink.

schema.label: Temperature glyph
schema.description: Marks the temperature figure (e.g. 󰁹 for battery/capsule,  for thermometer).

schema.label: Show clock speeds
schema.description: CPU average clock across all threads, and GPU core clock, in GHz.

schema.label: Clock glyph
schema.description: Marks the clock figure. The speedometer needs ~16px to stay distinct; on a smaller bar 󱑻 (square wave) or 󰥛 (sine wave) hold up better. Empty draws the number alone.

schema.label: Icon size (px)
schema.description: 0 follows the theme's bar icon size. Setting it scales this widget's glyphs, gauges, and numbers together — but only this widget, so it will no longer match the bar's other icons. To scale the whole bar, set [font] base-size in ~/.config/omarchy/shell.toml instead.

schema.label: Show gauges
schema.description: Show vertical gauges in the bar readout.

schema.label: GPU
schema.description: auto picks the card that reports load. Otherwise an index (0, 1) or a substring of the card, driver, or model name.

schema.label: Load warning threshold (%)
schema.description: Where a readout starts warming toward the theme's urgent color.

schema.label: Left click runs
schema.description: Command to run on left click (e.g. 'omarchy-launch-or-focus-tui btop'). Empty opens the built-in system telemetry panel.
